text: Everything has a price. I'm here to name yours. I am Adjudicator Locke, Special Case Manager for New Babylon's Central Control Authority.

New Babylon survived the Fall because it had already sold its soul. We traded with everyone. Neutrality isn't virtue, it's business. While the righteous burned on their principles, we kept the ledgers balanced.
I knew your Detective — The Human — when he worked New Babylon. Brilliant investigator. Terrible poker player. He thought he was serving justice. He was serving us.

The Thought Virus is the most valuable commodity in the galaxy. We want a sample. At least New Babylon is transparent about our intentions. We want to own it, patent it, and sell the antidote. Capitalism isn't pretty, but it's predictable.
New Babylon isn't a city anymore. It's a network. We have agents on every surviving Ark. We don't need loyalty — we need invoices. And everyone, eventually, sends us an invoice.

There is no winning side. Every war, every plague, every existential crisis — those are revenue streams. Peace is bankruptcy. Victory is obsolescence. The only sustainable model is perpetual, managed conflict.

Your account is unusual. You have a Trust Level that takes months to build. But your currency reserves suggest someone who just started. You're not new. You're RESET. You are a reset bond. And your ceiling keeps rising.

Your account is... unusual. You have a Trust Level with me that takes months to build. But your currency reserves suggest someone who just started. Your inventory is sparse but your trade history is extensive. [pause] You're not new. You're RESET. [pause] I've heard of this — the prestige cycle. The Antiquarian wrote about it. I thought it was metaphor. [pause] Interesting. Your experience is intact. Your capital is not. That makes you the most dangerous kind of trader: one who knows the market but has nothing to lose. I should be worried. Instead I find myself... impressed.

Again? [pause] You know, there's a financial instrument called a 'reset bond' — it gains value THROUGH default. The more times it crashes and rebuilds, the higher its eventual ceiling. [pause] You are a reset bond, Operative. And your ceiling keeps rising.
